The [[Singing Blade]] has a cutout along the length of the blade, with a pattern inscribed upon it.

**[[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]]

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the entire sword. The sword will be dyed to the color specified with the handle staying slightly darker than the rest of the sword. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye.

==Trivia==
* This sword's name is possibly a reference to a [[w:Tuning fork|tuning fork]]. Or it is possibly a reference to the Looney Tunes cartoon "Knighty Knight Bugs" (1957) with Bugs Bunny and the Singing Sword.
